bugs.text: Challenge stage soft-locks: challenge.remaining is decremented only when a fly-through enemy leaves the screen (1373); an enemy killed by the player (killEnemy 867-878, or bossKill) never decrements it, so once the player hits anything in a wave, remaining stays > 0, the next wave never spawns, enemies.length is 0 and nothing happens. Enter is ignored in state challenge (474-480), so the player must reload. Stage 3 is therefore the end of the game for anyone who scores a hit.

Dives only start when every enemy is in state formation. A captured fighter sits in state held forever, so after any capture no enemy dives again for the rest of the stage, the boss never dives with its captive, and the rescue / dual-fighter mechanic (901-903, 1309-1328) can never occur. The formation also stops breathing from that point.

Same gating serialises dives: no new dive while any enemy is diving or returning, so at most one dive group is airborne; the maxDivers stage ramp is dead code and later stages are barely more aggressive.

Entry paths for groups 2 and 3 start below the screen and sweep through the player's row (y ~250), and entering enemies fire; the bot lost all three ships within about 12 s of play on stage 1 in every run (4-play-015s.png shows GAME OVER with 16 shots fired, before any dive). Stage 1 is much harsher than the arcade.

Challenge hits score 50/80/150 instead of 100; a challenge Boss (health 1) is killed via bossKill for 150 and is never counted in totalHits/waveHits. 1,000 wave bonus and 10,000 PERFECT are unreachable.
Breathing scale snaps from 1+sin*0.06 to 1 the moment any enemy dives, visibly jolting the formation; sway never stops once the formation is complete.

Return paths target the formation position at the time the return starts, while the formation keeps swaying, so returning enemies jump a few px into their slot; escorts teleport from their escort offset straight to their slot when the boss finishes returning.
During READY no world update runs, so enemies, divers and bullets freeze in mid-air for a second, then resume.
P toggles pause on the title screen with no indication; the game then starts paused with a PAUSE overlay when Enter is pressed.
The tractor sound plays when the boss starts its dive, seconds before the beam appears; line 1451 contains the no-op condition e.beamTimer > e.beamTimer.

summary: The code is cleanly organised into state, update and render sections with sensible names, pixel-map sprites, a proper fixed-step loop and a complete synthesized sound set, and stages 1 and 2 look and feel like Galaga: curved entries, a swaying formation, a two-hit colour-changing Boss, aimed dives with escorts, a widening animated tractor beam that really captures the ship, stage badges and a hit-ratio screen. Two logic errors undercut the faithfulness badly. The dive scheduler is gated on every enemy being in formation, so a held captive silences all dives and makes the rescue, dual fighter and captive-fires-back mechanics unreachable even though they are coded; and the challenge-stage wave counter ignores kills, so the first challenging stage soft-locks for any player who scores a hit, and its scoring is wrong anyway. Stage 1 is also harsher than the arcade because entering enemies sweep through the player's row while firing, which cost the bot three ships in about twelve seconds in every run. What is reachable plays smoothly, but the signature mechanic and the challenge stage do not work as a player would experience them.
